title: ID0443906-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / S6 170003726] Modbus Load Management Out Of Service
description:
Reported Behavior/ Issue: Modbus Load Management Out Of Service
Solution: add IP address and port in Router 1 configuration - Open Ports to VLAN

additional_info.subject: Case Description
additional_info.body:
Hi Siemens Support Team,
the specified chargers are not able to communicate with the external modbus load management system. It seems, that the dedicated controller in the chargers is not reachable for the loadmangement controller, communication cannot be established for the loadmanagement controller.
The chargers are currently running using the fallback power of 178 kVA and therefore are only offering limited power to our customers.
Please check from your side.
Thanks and kind regards,
Marius Schneider
software version
: v7.0.5-0-gd66ba3a (PRODUCTION)
